window.rain: Frozen v2 package frames 2026-10-30T16Z..2026-11-02T07Z unchanged (Stage IV/MRMS analysis to 14Z Nov 1, then HRRR 2026-11-01T14Z forecast 14Z..07Z), then observed Stage IV 01h (IEM) for 07Z..18Z Nov 2 on the same grid and mapping; no HRRR in the extension, no zero-fill
window.note: Validation-only extended window so the observed inflow wave can pass Manville, Tucker and the outlet. Not a live configuration and not tuned.

roughnessSensitivity.hypothesis: The slow observed-inflow wave (~1.7 km/h) is caused by floodplain-shrub Manning n (WorldCover 20 -> 0.05) applied to a sand-bed channel. Tested, not fitted: n is a single published value chosen before any run.
roughnessSensitivity.change: Manning n set to 0.030 inside the channel mask (NHDPlus V2 flowlines, stream order >= 3, clipped to domain v2, each 100 m section buffered by half the 1 m lidar half-depth width, centred on the lidar channel where measured); every other n, terrain, mesh, boundary, rain and inflow value is the v2x case unchanged
roughnessSensitivity.source: Chow 1959 Table 5-6 A-1a natural minor stream, clean, straight, full stage: 0.025/0.030/0.033 (normal used); cross-check Arcement & Schneider 1989 USGS WSP 2339 sand channel base 0.012-0.026 plus modifiers
roughnessSensitivity.comparisonCase: brawley-avra-west-native-case-v2x-observed-inflow (same window, inflow, rain, boundaries; baseline n)
